latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor AI Maker — AI-driven video editing and export.

- Instantly turn raw 2-minute phone recordings into polished 1080p MP4 clips—just describe what you want.
- No manual timeline or export settings: upload, specify edits (e.g., "trim pauses, add background music"), and receive a ready clip in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic cloud setup with free anonymous usage (100 credits, 7-day expiry)—no installation required.
- Supports batch editing, session-based iterative workflow, and quick status/credits/export commands.
- Accepts popular video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB; outputs MP4, MOV, GIF, and more.
